geometry.note: Reactor containment building at the Hanbit (Yonggwang) Nuclear Power Plant, identified in OSM by power=generator, generator:source=nuclear. Assignment to reactor number R1 (of 6, numbered geographically southwest to northeast) is inferred from which numbering direction gives the best nonlinear least-squares fit of the RENO proposal's own per-reactor near/far detector distances (arXiv:1003.1391 Table 1.2) against these six OSM building positions (residuals under 6 m on distances of 300-1560 m for this SW-to-NE numbering, versus hundreds of metres for the reverse numbering or any other reactor-to-building permutation); see geometry:reno-near-detector method and the worklog. The table itself does not give reactor coordinates, only the SW-NE physical order of the six buildings is used, not a claim about which specific numbered unit (Hanbit's own operator-assigned Unit 1-6 numbering) each is.
